introduction.summary: This study aimed to determine the composition of syrphid fly communities in the Montreal metropolitan area and to quantify the impacts of site surface characteristics.

methods.summary: The study measured the larval functional traits of several syrphid fly species, categorizing them into four functional groups based on their habitat and nutritional needs. The study estimated the species richness and occupancy of syrphid flies across different sites during various trapping periods using a hierarchical model based on detection histories from traps of three different colors.
